notes:
v4.6.4 — bot metadata + auto pip install + Make Bot universe mode

🐛 FIXED
• Custom cloud bots no longer crash with ModuleNotFoundError. The Oracle server now preflights every custom bot start: it parses the new APEX-BOT-META block (if present), falls back to scanning the bot's import statements, then runs 'pip install' for any missing package into the shared venv. A marker file caches the result so subsequent starts skip the install. Fixes the CRYPTO bot's 'No module named sklearn' on first launch.

✨ NEW
• APEX-BOT-META block: every bot now declares its name, description, method, ai_used, compatible_models, asset_type, universe, and requirements in a docstring at the top of the file. The Make Bot AI prompt has been rewritten to require this block, so any bot you generate from now on carries enough metadata for the marketplace, the preflight installer, and the universe-compatibility check to work.
• Make Bot ‘Kind’ switch: pick Trading bot (default) or Universe bot. Universe bots are barred from placing orders and instead rewrite a *_universe.txt file that a trading bot consumes. The AI prompt switches based on the choice so you get a clean universe-generator, not a mangled trading bot.
• BOT_SKELETON.md fully updated with the META spec, the universe-bot path, and a clarification that local frozen builds can't pip install (cloud bots can).

📋 KNOWN LIMITATION
• The asset_type → universe compatibility filter (so a crypto bot can't accidentally use a stocks universe) lands in v4.6.5 alongside per-bot universe selection in the UI.
